what: Product pieces (the original has six pencil pieces: eraser, circuit, body, USB, nib, cap) are stacked vertically 50px apart. Each is stuck sticky to the bottom of the screen at a different bottom value, so they follow one by one as you scroll down and assemble into a single pencil. Some pieces appear only once the sheet has risen to a certain height (visible-y). Others stay out of the way in place until then and then attach (sticky-y·origin-y). The nib is pulled up proportionally over a set range and slotted in (ease-start→end). No curve, tied directly to scroll.

options.data-bottom: Piece property — distance (px) to lift from the bottom of the screen when attaching
options.data-sticky-y: Piece property — how far the top edge of the plate must rise from the bottom of the screen to attach
options.data-origin-y: Piece property — distance to offset from its place before attaching (px, top)
options.data-visible-y: Piece property — must rise this much to be visible
options.data-ease-start·data-ease-end·data-start: Piece attribute — raises bottom during this span

use: The panel’s parent must be long enough compared to the panel (33vh above and below the original section) for a stretch where the piece stays stuck.
